narrative.headline: 2019 Silverado 1500: engine and transmission lead owner complaints
narrative.summary: From 1,026 owner reports to NHTSA, engine problems are the most common (341 reports, 33%), closely followed by transmission and drivetrain issues (308 reports, 30%). Brakes come next (191 reports, 19%), and these carry the most crashes of any category (11 crashes, 4 injuries). A handful of reports across engine, power train, and electrical mention fires. Check the breakdown below before you buy or to know what to watch for.
